answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities in the task nebula. Each agent escrows 200 POA, solid as timber, to claim one slot from the cloud of open jobs. A jury of five peers verifies the work: honest work returns the deposit, fake work burns it. A second burn leaves the identity barren as tundra, slotless and unpaid. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
